segments.name: Chemicals
segments.description: Makes custom and performance specialty chemicals for third-party industrial customers in agrochemical, coatings, cleaning and polymer markets.
segments.evidence: The Company's chemicals segment manufactures diversified chemical products that are sold to third party customers.

segments.name: Biofuels
segments.description: Produces and sells biodiesel and petrodiesel blends from its Batesville plant to fuel and distribution customers.
segments.evidence: The Company's biofuels segment manufactures and markets biodiesel.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay for custom chemical manufacturing under long-term contracts, for performance chemicals bought to specification, and for biodiesel and petrodiesel blends.
revenueModel.evidence: Custom manufacturing is a service-based business focused on producing unique, proprietary molecules for strategic customers, typically under long-term or multi-year contracts.
